facts.text: Model-in-the-loop and software-in-the-loop are recommended for high-volume testing, with thousands of runs per night on cloud or on-premise compute.

facts.text: Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) is recommended for testing timing and real ECU behaviour.

facts.text: Machine-in-the-loop or vehicle-in-the-loop with augmented reality is recommended for closed-loop braking tests.
